name: The Warrior / The Doer
description: Raw assertive drive and the will to fight for one's own place; powerful, but apt to turn reckless and make enemies.
imagery: Armored warrior strides from fallen foe toward new conquest.
symbols: The fallen fighter on the slope
quote: I would rather lose as myself than win by waiting.

name: The Lover / The Mistress
description: Sensual beauty and material abundance; honouring the body without tipping into either indulgence or neglect.
imagery: Woman mirrors herself in a walled garden of plenty.
quote: I honor the body as the soul's honest dwelling.

name: The Mediator
description: Communication, curiosity and easy contact; lively, but inclined to stay on the surface and scatter.
imagery: Winged messenger leaves the city, scroll in hand.
quote: I carry the word between worlds and keep moving.

name: The Mother
description: Nurturing devotion and unconditional care, where deep bonds may either feed growth or breed dependency.
imagery: Veiled mother cradles a golden child under the moon.
symbols: Her robe dissolving into water and flowers
quote: I hold you until you can hold yourself.

name: The Servitor / The Ego
description: The inner sovereign wanting recognition and centre stage; creative authority shading into vanity.
imagery: Enthroned king in crimson receives the city's gaze.
quote: I shine, and the world arranges itself around my light.

name: The Regulator
description: Sacred purpose found in daily labour; disciplined service that turns routine into meaning.
imagery: Woman prays before a humble stove in open field.
symbols: Sheaf of wheat and harvest basket
quote: The sacred lives in the task done again tomorrow.

name: The Partner
description: Harmonious partnership and mutual complement, with codependency as the shadow side.
imagery: Courtyard couple in finery converse beneath climbing roses.
quote: I am only whole where we meet as equals.

name: The Seducer / The Idea
description: Seduction carrying a hidden price; an attractive surface concealing treacherous depths.
imagery: Pale seducer extends an open hand amid flames.
symbols: Sharp widow's peak and pale features
quote: Everything I offer will cost you something true.

name: The Preacher / The Search For Meaning
description: Spiritual authority and teaching within tradition; genuine faith that can harden into dogma.
imagery: Priest blesses beneath a radiant crowned vision.
quote: I keep the fire meaning once carried.

name: The Master / The Old Wise Man
description: Wisdom earned through experience; introspection and acceptance of destiny, tempted by isolation.
imagery: Hooded ascetic reads on a snowy mountain ledge.
quote: Time teaches what shortcut cannot.

name: The Jester / The Releaser
description: Freedom and authenticity outside convention; originality bought at the cost of stability.
imagery: Motley jester walks the mountain road under lightning.
symbols: The bells on cap and shoes
The bundle and puppet on his staff
His steady stride down the open path
quote: I owe convention nothing but a joke.

name: The Angel / The Search for Salvation
description: Intuition, grace and spiritual awakening, shadowed by escapism and loss of contact with reality.
imagery: Winged figure pours golden water beneath a rainbow.
symbols: Water poured from the golden bowl in her hands
Her robe dissolving into the river
The grazing horses and lilies below
quote: I let what is given flow where it is needed.

name: The Defiance
description: The rebellious child pushing against maternal authority — destructive, but necessary to individuation.
imagery: Defiant boy marches from watching mother under grey clouds.
quote: I must break away to become someone at all.

name: The Two Faces of Eve / The Two Souls
description: Mother and lover within one woman, either torn between roles or made whole by them.
imagery: Mirror shows one woman as mother and as lover.
quote: Both souls in me are mine to reconcile.

name: Articulation / Talking Things Over
description: Naming feelings instead of suppressing them, and reading the signs fate sends.
imagery: Hermes steadies a woman mid-feeling beneath a dark moon.
quote: Feelings become bearable the moment they are named.

name: The Incompatibility
description: Two figures facing opposite ways yet holding hands — union that preserves difference.
imagery: Naked couple back to back, hands clasped at the tree.
quote: We hold hands precisely because we face different worlds.

name: The Caring
description: Devoted nurturing that can tip into smothering; boundaries needed alongside love.
imagery: Woman tucks the cradle's blanket in lamplit nursery.
quote: My love keeps watch long past its need.

name: The Family
description: A third thing created together, which must eventually be released to its own life.
imagery: Parents kneel at a stream, child reaching between them.
symbols: The irises at the water's edge
The stream's bend toward the horizon
quote: Together we make a third thing that must leave us.

name: The Abortion
description: Something precious sacrificed to immediate desire; destruction that still holds rebirth.
imagery: Masked figure gives a swaddled infant to the flames.
symbols: The swaddled infant above the flames
quote: Something precious dies so something honest can begin.

name: Mnemosyne
description: Memory as the bridge to the unconscious; ancestral and karmic patterns surfacing.
imagery: Star-crowned goddess stands where two landscapes meet.
symbols: The flowing stream at her feet
quote: I am the river running through everything remembered.

name: The Ice Queen
description: Feeling frozen for safety's sake; outward composure bought with inner loneliness.
imagery: Tearful queen mirrors herself before an unreachable castle.
quote: I would rather be perfect and alone than open and hurt.

name: Deliverance / The Delivery
description: Leaving security for independence — cold and unwelcoming at first, but growth.
imagery: Figure hatches from a cracked egg into cold marsh dawn.
symbols: The braced hand on the shell
The open marsh beyond the egg
quote: I leave the shell knowing the wet ground will hold me.

name: The Sleeping Beauty
description: Waiting to be rescued: deep intuitive gifts, or retreat into infantile dream.
imagery: Sleeping woman waits in a bower of thorned roses.
quote: Awakened by another, I never learn to wake myself.

name: The Battle
description: Meeting an equal opponent who turns out to mirror one's own shadow aggression.
imagery: Two armored warriors lock swords under a blazing sun.
quote: My equal shows me the face of my own force.

name: The Queen / The Empress
description: The Beloved fused with the Ego: magnetism, status, and the pride that isolates.
imagery: Enthroned emerald queen holds a single ripe apple.
symbols: The single apple in her hand
The rose-shaped clasps on her gown
quote: I am the prize, and the prize is lonely.

name: The Actor
description: Roles and masks — performance as protection, or as a route to self-discovery.
imagery: Crowned actor proclaims from a stage over waiting wigs.
quote: I become real by playing, and lose myself by only playing.

name: The Ailing King
description: Worldly achievement losing its meaning; withdrawal from power in order to heal.
imagery: The ailing king reaches for a book beside his crown.
quote: I set the crown down to find what crowned it.

name: The Wedding / The Marriage
description: Ego meeting Pair — union at its peak, socially blessed, and by nature fleeting.
imagery: Bride and groom exchange rose and glove beneath the arch.
quote: For one bright moment, everything joins.

name: The Magician
description: Creating life through knowledge and pride; great power emptied of love.
imagery: Old sorcerer stirs the alembic beneath a black sun.
symbols: The black sun at the window
quote: I can make anything live except what loves me.

name: Fortuna
description: Talent and opportunity converging; gifts that arrive carrying obligation.
imagery: Golden stars pour over a figure's open arms.
quote: The gift falls; my task is to deserve it.

name: The Burden
description: Sisyphean duty, whether genuine responsibility or self-imposed punishment.
imagery: Stooped man climbs ice under a strapped boulder.
quote: I carry it because no one else will, or because I would not put it down.

name: The Fall
description: The Fool topples the King and holds up a mirror: status lost, truth gained.
imagery: Jester on the throne shows the kneeling king a mirror.
symbols: The lion at the throne's foot
quote: Stripped of rank, I finally see myself.

name: Retreat / The Withdrawal
description: Turning inward; the ego dissolved through contemplation and deliberate non-action.
imagery: Golden figure meditates in a ring of white lotus.
symbols: The closed eyes and folded hands
quote: I step out of the game to remember who plays.

name: The Eros
description: Mars tempered by Venus into desire and creative union; attraction resting on trust and openness.
imagery: Nude couple clasp hands beneath a rose-woven arch.
quote: I meet you with my whole self, unarmored.

name: The Stocks / The Pillory
description: Gossip and moral superiority; hasty judgement of others used to elevate oneself.
imagery: Pilloried woman endures the square's pointing fingers.
quote: The crowd feels righteous exactly where it feels guilty.

name: The Guilt
description: Good intentions pursued by crude means, leaving the goal unreached and only regret behind.
imagery: Warrior strides past the unicorn drinking at the falls.
quote: In rushing toward my goal I trample what I meant to honor.

name: Disagreement / The Quarrel
description: Rigid positions opening a deep rift in a place where love still remains beneath.
imagery: Two figures face across a rift with a wedged sword.
symbols: His raised hand, her crossed arms
quote: We stand apart over ground love still holds beneath.

name: The Vampire
description: Feeding on another's life force without return; dependency dressed up as intimacy.
imagery: Cloaked figure waits motionless on a darkened path.
quote: I feed on you because I cannot feed myself.

name: The Crusader
description: Conviction imposed by force rather than persuasion; belief hardened into fanaticism.
imagery: Crusader rides with raised sword toward a burning city.
symbols: The gaze fixed on the burning city
quote: My belief justifies any fire it lights.

name: The Prevention
description: Struggling against a destiny not meant for you, pride mistaking a limit for an obstacle.
imagery: Knight drives his sword against an immovable boulder.
quote: I fight the wall instead of reading the map.

name: The Spiteful Troublemaker / The Poisoned Dwarf
description: The trickster provoking order, acting out of rejection and alienation.
imagery: Wild dwarf leaps over the bonfire in manic mockery.
quote: Rejected by the fire, I will dance in it anyway.

name: The Absolute Fool / The Pure Fool
description: Heroic fantasy cut loose from reality; noble dreams tilting at windmills.
imagery: Luminous knight stands while a gray knight slumps exhausted.
symbols: The roses at the sleeper's side
quote: I charge what no real horse could reach.

name: The Golden Girl
description: Intellect and feeling, beauty and wisdom — two feminine aspects competing or integrating.
imagery: Rose-cloaked beauty and indigo scholar stand beneath the arch.
symbols: The flower crown and garden roses
quote: Head and heart argue until they learn each other's language.

name: Clinging / The Adherence
description: Accumulation as both protection and prison, driven by a deep fear of loss.
imagery: Woman stacks coin towers before a barred, cracking wall.
quote: I hold on because letting go feels like dying.

name: The Gilded Cage / The Golden Cage
description: Security traded for freedom in a bond built on possession rather than love.
imagery: Gowned woman sits locked in a gilded, padlocked cage.
symbols: The trinkets on the shelf behind her
The roses grown at the cage's foot
quote: The cage is golden, but the door still locks.

name: The Marionette / The Puppet
description: Beautiful but hollow, moved by others' strings and by its own material appetite.
imagery: Strings hold the smiling porcelain doll en pointe.
quote: Beautiful, and moved by hands I pretend not to feel.

name: Matter and Spirit
description: Sacrifice offered for spiritual gain; the danger of reducing the sacred to a transaction.
imagery: Monk lifts the offering bowl beneath temple columns.
symbols: The statue in the dark niche
The stacked treasures beside the altar
quote: I give so that heaven will notice me.

name: Responsibility For Creation
description: Mature responsibility freely taken for what is vulnerable; service over acquisition.
imagery: Robed steward feeds birds with a lamb against his chest.
symbols: Birds alighting on his open hand
The lamb cradled against his chest
His bare feet on the earth
quote: What is vulnerable in my keeping is my vow.

name: The Farewell
description: Separation and material division that clears the ground for something new.
imagery: Traveler waves farewell as lightning splits the sky.
symbols: The tumbled wall by the roadside
quote: I divide what I have to clear ground for what comes.

name: The Garden of Spirits
description: Ordinary duties infused with soul, finding the magic inside everyday chores.
imagery: Kneeling gardener sees spirits dance above her labor.
symbols: The luminous circle of dancing spirits
The lily pool within the vision
The manor house at the garden's edge
quote: The mundane task done with soul becomes a door.

name: The Strategist
description: Pure calculating intellect: masterful at planning, hollow of feeling and connection.
imagery: Spectacled strategist moves a chess piece among scattered figures.
symbols: The globe, telescope, and star map
The pieces scattered beneath the table
The twin candles on one stand, in a shadowed study
quote: I win the game and lose the reason for playing.

name: The Vanity Fair
description: Seeing and being seen; pleasant, superficial display in place of real contact.
imagery: Elegant couple promenades the square while all watch.
symbols: The couple's linked arms and turned profiles
The couple watching from the window
The second couple's exchange by the entrance
quote: Being seen has quietly replaced seeing.

name: The Pied Piper
description: Charm used to lead and manipulate; the seduction of crowds by a persuasive voice.
imagery: Piper leads an enchanted townful through the gateway.
quote: Follow my music and I will decide where the road ends.

name: Master And Student / Master And Pupil
description: Teaching and learning as a single cycle, each of us occupying both roles.
imagery: Young pupil pours at the fire before a watching master.
quote: Each of us is student and master by turns.

name: Affliction / The Ailment
description: The wounded messenger going on despite injury, with endurance as the lesson.
imagery: Bandaged traveler crutches on across barren stone.
quote: Wounded, I still carry the message through.

name: Dreamy Johnny / Little Johnny Head-In-Air
description: Head in the clouds and missing the ditch ahead; vision that needs grounding.
imagery: Head tilted skyward, Johnny nears the broken pier planks.
quote: I watch the sky so hard I miss the ditch.

name: The Silence
description: Wordless understanding between close souls, and truths that cannot be spoken aloud.
imagery: Winged figure hushes two mirrored souls holding hands.
quote: What we understand together needs no words.

name: Everyday Life In The Relationship / The Routine
description: Routine and obligation — meaning in small things, or soul-numbing repetition.
imagery: Man splits logs while woman scrubs, neither looking up.
symbols: The tidy cottage and potted plant
quote: The days hold together, and something quietly starves.

name: Castigation / The Mortification
description: Guilt turned into self-punishment in the pursuit of purity.
imagery: Kneeling figure raises the scourge over a bared back.
quote: I hurt myself to feel clean.

name: The Inquisition
description: Harsh judgement of others while remaining blind to one's own faults.
imagery: Three judges condemn a lone woman beneath the black cross.
quote: I sentence others for the faults I refuse to see in myself.

name: The Fear
description: Phobia and paralysis; vital force withheld by anxieties often inherited.
imagery: Elderly woman recoils from a shrouded figure among graves.
quote: I stop living where the fear says to stop.

name: The Furies / The Erinyes
description: Vengeance and paranoia that consume the one who harbours them.
imagery: Serpent-haired fury hurls bolts at a crouching figure.
symbols: The serpents in her raised arms
quote: My hunt for the guilty becomes the thing destroying me.

name: Deception / The Illusion / The Deceit
description: A game in which no one wins; the manipulator mirroring one's own self-deception.
imagery: Three robed men crouch over a wagered board game.
quote: The game is rigged, and I am all three players.

name: Disaster / The Doom
description: Love become obsession, with bonds forced through control rather than chosen.
imagery: Shackled couple stand beneath a flaming taloned shadow.
quote: What I call love has locked our wrists together.

name: The Symbolon
description: Two souls joined in shared purpose — the rare, transforming partnership.
imagery: Two robed figures walk arm in arm toward a temple.
quote: Together we become a third thing neither could be alone.

name: Sadness / The Mourning
description: Grief and irreversible loss; mourning that has to be lived through fully.
imagery: Black-dressed woman mourns beside a broken column.
quote: I let the sorrow be as large as the love was.

name: The Separation
description: Separation as release: leaving what constrains in order to grow.
imagery: Winged woman rises on heron as a figure releases her.
quote: I lift away from what held me, and bless it.

name: Two King’s Children
description: Love lived in idealisation, with impossible standards keeping real contact away.
imagery: Youth reaches from his cliff toward an unreachable princess.
symbols: Her stillness on the far cliff
quote: I love a dream precisely because it cannot answer.

name: The Black Mass
description: False idols and fanaticism; the individual dissolved into the crowd.
imagery: Hooded crowd kneels before an inverted, burning cross.
quote: I disappear into the crowd and call it devotion.

name: The Depression
description: Petrified withdrawal from life's flow, still carrying the seed of renewal.
imagery: Man sits hunched in a cave of hanging pale spirits.
symbols: The shrouded ancestor spirits and the roosting bat
quote: Frozen in the dark, I keep a candle lit anyway.

name: The Phoenix
description: Total destruction as the price of freedom, and rebirth out of the ashes.
imagery: Blazing phoenix rises over a city consumed in flame.
quote: I burn the old life to be born from its ashes.

name: The False Halo / The Halo
description: Good and evil housed in one person; integrating shadow without hypocrisy.
imagery: Two-faced winged figure bears a split dark-and-gold halo.
symbols: The two faces merged as one
quote: I house my darkness and my light in one body, honestly.

name: The Confession
description: Speaking one's truth, and the duty owed by the one who receives it.
imagery: Hooded traveler kneels confessing before the stern bishop.
symbols: The traveler's bundle, set down beside him
quote: I speak what I did, and let it cost what it costs.

name: The Quantum Leap / The Quantum Jump
description: Hierophant and Fool together: a leap clean past one's former limits.
imagery: Motley jester leaps unsupported across the sheer chasm.
quote: I jump the gap no step of mine has earned.

name: The Pythia
description: Prophetic intuition, with a razor-thin line between vision and distortion.
imagery: Veiled priestess kneels in vapor before the watching king.
quote: I speak what rises, and cannot always tell it true.

name: Captivity / The Imprisonment
description: Desire meeting immovable constraint; peace found within the limits themselves.
imagery: Motley jester grips the prison bars, wistful and still.
quote: Within walls I cannot move, I find the peace they hold.

name: The Moira
description: Accepting with grace a destiny that cannot be argued with or altered.
imagery: Robed old woman pinches the black strand beside her blade.
symbols: The blade resting close at hand
quote: What cannot be argued with can still be met with dignity.

name: The Grail Question
description: The search for lost sacred knowledge, open only to the fully purified.
imagery: Stained-glass grail radiates above rising blue waves.
quote: Only the purified heart may ask the question that restores.
